scripts.vendor:sync: rsync -a --delete /root/.hermes/workspace/opencode-memory-pro/dist/ vendor/dist/ && cp /root/.hermes/workspace/opencode-memory-pro/LICENSE vendor/ 2>/dev/null; cp /root/.hermes/workspace/opencode-memory-pro/opencode-memory-pro.example.json vendor/ 2>/dev/null; echo 'vendor synced'
